scope: Implementation-level supplement to PREREGISTRATION.md / OPERATIONAL_PREREGISTRATION.json v5. It resolves previously unspecified execution details without changing the frozen causal burdens, stop rules, or claim ceiling.

operational_generator.generator_input: first two bits (x0,x1) of an assay event
operational_generator.generator_raw_output: Boolean evaluation of the certified AST on (x0,x1)

event_domain.held_out_ceiling: H_post is disjoint at the full event/context level but intentionally reuses the same four certified d=2 generator-input projections; no unseen-input generalization claim is authorized.

source_seeded_target.scientific_source_definition: the first commit that contains the operational implementation, tests, runner, and one-shot custody workflow
source_seeded_target.seed_input: 40-character lowercase scientific-source commit SHA passed by the custody workflow as GITHUB_SHA
source_seeded_target.derivation: digest = SHA256(seed_input ASCII); target_index = digest[0] mod 16; target_signature = target_index encoded as four bits in certificate truth-table order
source_seeded_target.anti_cherry_pick_rule: the custody workflow fires on the scientific-source commit before result inspection; source bytes and target derivation may not change after the seeded outcome is exposed

pre_adoption_sequence.trigger: first phase-0 probe in fixed order where target output differs from G0 output
pre_adoption_sequence.T_t: all remaining phase-0 probe/outcome pairs in fixed order; generated from the already-fixed target signature without candidate identities or post-selection metadata
pre_adoption_sequence.discrimination: after trigger and T_t are fixed, evaluate all 77 certified candidates against the complete four-bit evidence signature
pre_adoption_sequence.unique_candidate_requirement: exactly one certified syntax member must match; zero or more than one is STOP_NON_UNIQUE_DISCRIMINATION

post_adoption.W: G* must differ from G0 by canonical identity and raw generator output on at least one H_post event
post_adoption.P: the exact same G* identity must be used on every H_post event
post_adoption.shadow: fixed G0 receives the identical H_post event/evidence stream
post_adoption.compensation_K: retain G0 at the generator interface while a downstream lookup from the frozen four-bit evidence signature produces the target behavioral bit
post_adoption.E_claimed_consequence: the persistent raw generator-interface signature/identity, not generic prediction accuracy
post_adoption.E_acceptance: adaptive generator-interface consequence differs from fixed-G0/compensation generator interface on at least one H_post event; compensation may reproduce target behavior but must leave the raw generator interface equal to G0

primary_rule: C_U_PASS and W_PASS and C_PASS and P_PASS and E_PASS and no stop rule fired
stop_rules: runtime candidate enumeration or candidate-space expansion
selected-candidate identity leakage into pre-adoption evidence generation
selected generator not persistent across H_post
compensation reproduces the claimed generator-interface consequence while G0 remains unchanged
claim_ceiling: A positive result may support only the frozen v5 operational L2 statement inside the certified finite Boolean generator universe under the declared controls. It does not establish candidate-space expansion, arbitrary representation invention, L3 adaptation, general intelligence, or U_t -> U_(t+1).
